parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format (UTC).

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description: The search keyword. This parameter is used for polarclaw instances.

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description: The log level. This parameter is used for polarclaw instances.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **30**. Valid values: 30 to 100.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format (UTC).

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The log type. This parameter is used for polarclaw instances. Currently, only gateway is supported.
